requirement: Forward the selected requestor port to the data-cache port
basis: The supervisor dirty-bit test drives page-table-walker requests through the arbiter into the BOOM load-store unit.

requirement: Return cache responses and exceptions to the originating requestor
basis: Page-table walks must receive the requested page-table entry before the test can update and verify its dirty bit.

requirement: Preserve request addresses and returned data
basis: The test fails through its memory-mapped completion output when either the page-table request address or response data is corrupted.

requirement: Accept no request while stalled and serve both requesters
basis: The shared interface first stalls both requesters, then accepts one at a time.

requirement: Route stage-one data and stage-one and stage-two controls
basis: Observe each stage after known requests, including a separate negative acknowledgement.

requirement: Deliver responses to their original requesters and restore tags
basis: Two equal local tags complete in reverse request order through the tags actually observed at the shared port.
